files.NOTES.md: The cache never expired entries. The ttl in the config is a string with a unit, so reading it as a number gave a bad value. I now parse it, and the cache expires entries as expected.
The config stores the ttl as text, "90s", and src/config.js read it as a plain number. That gave NaN, so the expiry check never fired. It now goes through the duration parser.
I changed the comparison in cache.js from > to >= and the test ttl handling.
